verdict.rationale: An agent can drive the core flows through the REST API. It can create account authorisations (embedded and pre-authorisation), re-authorise lapsed consents, retrieve accounts, balances and transactions with a consent token, and use an OpenAPI spec for client generation. However, the MCP surface only gives agents searchable access to the documentation, not platform operations. Authentication is a single HTTP Basic application ID/secret rather than scoped agent credentials. Missing for 10: an operational MCP server (current MCP is docs-only), scoped/least-privilege API credentials, documented consent listing/revocation for full connection management, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
